parameters.content:
## 09 Speed To Lead Responder

First response on the channel the lead arrived on, inside business hours, queued outside them.

**Safety rails:** Calls 16-safety-rails before any outbound action.

**Before you enable this:** replace every REPLACE_WITH_* value, point CRM_BASE_URL/CRM_ADAPTER at your CRM, and run it once manually with test data.

Docs: README.md, docs/SETUP.md, docs/COMPLIANCE.md

nodes.name: Called By Capture Flow
nodes.notes: Called by 01, 02, 03 and 10 the moment a lead lands.

nodes.name: Queue For Next Open Hour
nodes.notes: Out of hours we queue rather than send. 11-followup-sequence drains this table.

nodes.name: Safety Rails
nodes.notes: Calls 16-safety-rails. Nothing that can reach a prospect runs before the rails return allowed=true.

nodes.name: Rails Allowed?
nodes.notes: False branch is a dead end by design.

parameters.subject: ={{ $env.FIRST_RESPONSE_SUBJECT || 'Thanks for reaching out' }}
parameters.text: ={{ $env.FIRST_RESPONSE_BODY || 'Thanks for getting in touch. What are you trying to get done, and by when? Reply STOP to opt out.' }}

nodes.name: Send Email Reply
nodes.notes: Keep the opt-out line in the body. It is the cheapest compliance control you have.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $('Business Hours Check').item.json.lead.phone, body: ($env.FIRST_RESPONSE_SMS || 'Thanks for reaching out - what are you trying to get done? Reply STOP to opt out.') }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ handle: $('Business Hours Check').item.json.lead.handle, text: ($env.FIRST_RESPONSE_DM || 'Thanks for the message - what are you trying to get done?') }) }}

parameters.query:
=UPDATE leads SET first_response_at = COALESCE(first_response_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE email_key = lower(nullif('{{ $('Business Hours Check').item.json.lead.email }}', ''));

nodes.name: Update SLA Clock
nodes.notes: COALESCE keeps the FIRST response time. 13-daily-pipeline-digest reports on it.
